summary: Two churches (St. James, Montague; St. Thomas, Sandyston). Mass and Saturday Confession times agree in both bulletins read (Nov 8, Nov 15) and on the website; Friday 10-noon Adoration at St. Thomas recurs in both calendars; the website adds a Nov 26 Thanksgiving Mass. Open: Saturday Adoration after the 8 AM Mass at St. James (no start time printed), and the Knights' second-Tuesday 6:30 PM Adoration.

slots.rationale: R30: a named second-Tuesday service (R12: the newest week holds no second Tuesday, so the Nov 8 issue, whose week does, is cited). It is printed as part of the Knights' council meeting, and nothing says whether the Adoration is open to all; the calendar lists it publicly at STC (St. Thomas Church or the Fr. Lewis Center on its grounds), so leaning include. No end time: it runs until the 7 PM meeting (POLICY, Times).
